text.tspan: One transaction governs validation, snapshot, selection and all audit writes
Any failed guard exits at its step, without executing later calls
Preserve material, sequence, quantity and unit, allocate fresh item IDs
Old selection Y to N, old content and release facts stay unchanged
Failure can occur at any write above, all changes share this transaction

g.text: [Any persistence or audit step fails before commit]

text.tspan: Published label, declarations and label pointer remain unchanged

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;

svg.text: Submit product + exact source formula + target specification IDs
Adopt newer specification explicitly
Authenticate and require DATA.MAINTAIN + FORMULA.RELEASE
Reject identity or authorization
401 AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED or 403 AUTHORIZATION_DENIED
Error, no catalog or adoption audit writes
Serialize product, then exact source version
Current pointer, source release state and source items
Check source ownership, RELEASED state, current pointer and Y flag
Serialize distinct material IDs in sorted order
Serialize target + source specification IDs in sorted order
Exact specification versions and evidence
Validate specification/material bindings, target eligibility and newness
400 / 404 / 409 / 422 business rejection
Stable error, no new snapshot or audit residue
Create fresh draft at highest allocated version + 1
Copy all items, replace target-material specification references
FORMULA_CREATED
Release new formula and select it as current
FORMULA_RELEASED
FORMULA_SPECIFICATION_ADOPTED with source, target and new IDs
Commit transaction
Released new formula snapshot with items
201 Created
Roll back snapshot, items, selection and all audit events
Conflict or generic internal error
409 DATA_CONFLICT or 500 INTERNAL_ERROR
